result.instructions:
Pollar is a Stellar wallet-as-a-service platform. This server is a read/write gateway over a
developer's own hub-api account, authenticated by the Personal Access Token (PAT) the client sends.

Getting oriented: call `whoami` first to see the developer identity and the applications in scope,
or `list_applications`. Then use `get_application` / `check_application_readiness` for one app.

Scopes: every tool needs a scope on the PAT — reads need `<resource>:read`, writes need `<resource>:write`
(resources: applications, api_keys, wallets, assets, transactions, users, distribution). A 403
PAT_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE means the token lacks that scope; the error message names the exact scope to grant.

Wallet roles: a new app has one GLOBAL wallet. Once "split", the former global becomes FUNDING and there are
also GAS and DISTRIBUTION wallets; GLOBAL no longer resolves. Ask for a role with `get_application_wallet_by_role`.

Networks: testnet wallets can be funded automatically via friendbot (`fund_testnet_wallet` / `ensure_wallet_funded`).
Mainnet has no friendbot — fund those by transferring XLM to the wallet public key.
